theme: Tricky spellings: Its vs It's, Then vs Than...

pages.title: Look forward to
pages.meaning: to feel happy about something coming
examples: I look forward to the weekend.
We look forward to meeting you.

pages.title: Then vs Than
pages.intro: One letter makes a big difference.

pages.title: Let the cat out of the bag
pages.meaning: to reveal a secret by mistake
examples: Who let the cat out of the bag?
She let the cat out of the bag.

pages.title: Come across
pages.meaning: to find or meet by chance
examples: I came across an old photo.
Have you come across this word?
